original: 今回は、アルマナック遺跡にある\n「暁の従者」の拠点へ行ってちょうだい
traducao: Please head to the Servants of the Dawn's\nbase located in the Almanac Ruins.

original: 「暁の従者」は、あの得体のしれない\n光る存在を、救世主「ディセンダー」として、\nルバーブ連山から連れ出した宗教団体よ
traducao: The Servants of the Dawn is the cult\nthat took that mysterious glowing entity\nfrom Rhubarb Mountains as the Descender.

original: 彼らは、ナタリアの国であるライマ国\nばかりでなく、様々な所で暴動を\n起こしているらしいの
traducao: They seem to be inciting riots not only\nin Natalia's home, the Kingdom of Lima,\nbut in various other regions as well.

original: 彼らの拠点に、\nきっとあの光る存在も\nいるでしょう
traducao: That glowing entity is almost certainly\npresent at their base\nas well.

original: 早く、彼らから切り離さなければ\n大変な事になってしまう
traducao: If we do not separate it from them soon,\nthe consequences will be dire.

original: 今回は、わたしとジェイドさんが同行するから
traducao: Jade and I will accompany you this time.

original: 準備が整ったら、すぐに発ちましょう
traducao: Once you are ready, let us depart at once.

original: ホントさ。\nディセンダー様が手から金を\n山の様に出したんだ
traducao: It is true!\nThe Descender produced a mountain of gold\nstraight from their own hands!

original: しかし、ディセンダー様は、\n救世主という自覚がおありでない。\n自分が何者かもわからないとは…
traducao: Yet the Descender has no awareness\nof being a savior, not even knowing\ntheir own true identity...

original: ほら、予言でも言うだろう。\nディセンダーは、世界樹から生まれたばかりで\n記憶というものがない
traducao: Come now, the prophecy states that too.\nA Descender just born from the World Tree\npossesses no memories whatsoever.

original: 恐怖すら知らないとな
traducao: They do not even know fear, it says.

original: 少し前に、俺達の間で裏切り者が出たって\n話があっただろう？
traducao: Not long ago, didn't we hear talk\nof a traitor among our ranks?

original: 先日、その裏切り者に罰をお与え下さいって\n願った奴がいたんだよ
traducao: The other day, someone begged the\nDescender to punish that traitor.

original: そうするとディセンダー様は、\n表情一つ変えずに…
traducao: And then, without changing expression\neven in the slightest...

original: ああ、むごい。\n口に出すのもはばかられる程の\nものだった
traducao: Ah, it was horrifying...\nSomething so cruel, one could hardly\nbring oneself to speak of it.

original: 恐怖という感情があれば…、\n確かにあんな事は出来ないだろう
traducao: If one possessed the emotion of fear...\nthey could never do such a thing.

original: 俺もディセンダー様に\n願いを叶えてもらいたいものだ
traducao: I too would love to have a wish\ngranted by the Descender.

original: 無理さ。\n司祭クラスの許可なくしては\n会えないんだろうし
traducao: Impossible.\nOne cannot meet them without permission\nfrom the high priest class.

original: やっぱり、この奥が彼らの拠点なのね
traducao: So their base truly lies deeper within.

original: ここは、太古にあったディセンダー信仰の\n場所だったそうだから、彼らも拠点として\nここを選んだんでしょうね
traducao: This was once an ancient site\nof Descender worship, so that is likely\nwhy they chose it as their stronghold.

original: ディセンダー様、ですか
traducao: Lord Descender, is it?

original: そのいかがわしい存在も\nここに隠しているんでしょうかねぇ…
traducao: I wonder if that shady entity\nis hidden in here as well...

original: はぁぁぁぁ…ッ！
traducao: Haaaaah...!

original: 見ろ、この力！\nラザリス様がくれたんだ
traducao: Behold this power!\nLord Lazaris granted it to me!

original: 素晴らしい！
traducao: Magnificent!

original: ああ、この力をもって、\n我々のディセンダー・ラザリス様と共に\nすべての民を平等な世界へと導くんだ
traducao: Indeed! With this very power, alongside\nour Descender, Lord Lazaris, we shall\nlead all people to a world of equality!

original: んっ、何だお前達は？\n我々の同志になりに来たのか？
traducao: Hm? Who are you lot?\nHave you come to join our cause?

original: いいえ、そうではないの
traducao: No, that is not why we are here.

original: じゃあ、何の目的で来たんだ？
traducao: Then for what purpose have you come?

original: あなた方がディセンダーと呼んでいるものを\n引き渡してもらいます
traducao: We must ask you to hand over\nwhat you refer to as the Descender.

original: あれは、ディセンダーなんかじゃないの。\nもっと得体の知れない何かよ
traducao: That thing is no Descender.\nIt is something far more sinister.

original: そう、危険な存在かもしれませんよ
traducao: Indeed, it may be quite dangerous.

original: 危険な存在だと？\nバカな事を…
traducao: A dangerous entity, you say?\nWhat utter foolishness...

original: 今は誕生されたばかりで、予言通り\n名前以外何も記憶はない
traducao: Having just been born, as the prophecy\nforetold, they recall only their name.

original: だが、今この奥でこの世の事を\n学んでおられるのだ
traducao: Yet even now, deep within this sanctum,\nthey are learning of this world.

original: それが終わるまで、誰もこの先へは\n通すわけには行かないのだ
traducao: Until that is complete, we cannot allow\na single soul to pass beyond this point!

original: この腐敗した世の中を正す為に\n降臨されたディセンダー様だ
traducao: The Descender descended to this realm\nsolely to rectify this corrupt world!

original: じきに、自ら立ち上がられ、\nこの世界を理想郷へと造り変えられる。\n邪魔はさせないぞ！！
traducao: Soon they will rise of their own accord\nand remake this world into an utopia.\nWe shall not allow you to interfere!!

original: やれやれ、ずいぶんな熱の入れ様ですね。\n話になりません
traducao: Good grief, quite the zealots, aren't\nthey? There is no reasoning with them.

original: 我等に勝てると思うな！\nディセンダー様より授かった力、\nとくと見よ！！
traducao: Do not think you can defeat us!\nBehold the boundless power\nbestowed upon us by the Descender!!

original: 性懲りもなく、また来たか！
traducao: You still have not learned your lesson?!

original: ディセンダー様を守り、\n付き従うのが我等「暁の従者」の使命！\nここは何人たりとも通さんぞ！！
traducao: To protect and serve the Descender is\nthe mission of the Servants of the Dawn!\nNone shall pass beyond this point!!

original: くっ…、やるな！
traducao: Kh...! Not bad!

original: だが、まだ屈しはせんぞ
traducao: Yet we shall never surrender!

original: 一部の者ばかりが益を得る\n腐った世の仕組み。\n必ずやディセンダー様が打ち砕く
traducao: This rotten system where only a select\nfew reap the benefits... The Descender\nshall surely shatter it to pieces!

original: 搾取のない、平等で平和な世界を\n望んでいる者達の声の為にも…
traducao: For the voices of all who yearn for\na peaceful, equal world without greed...

original: ディセンダー様を\nお前達に渡すわけには行かない！！
traducao: We cannot possibly hand over\nthe Descender to the likes of you!!

original: 世を変えるにも、\nディセンダー頼りですか。\nそれでは、何も変わりませんよ
traducao: Relying on the Descender even to change\nthe world? If that is your approach,\nnothing will ever change, you know.

original: 黙れ！！
traducao: Silence!!

original: 何だ…、これは
traducao: What... is this...?

original: 身体が…、身体がぁぁぁぁ！！
traducao: My body... My bodyyyy!!

original: ヒィッ！？\nな、何だっ、この姿は！！
traducao: Eeeek?!\nWh-What is this form?!

original: まさか…、生物変化現象！？
traducao: Could it be... a creature mutation?!

original: あぁぁ、…なぜ。\nなぜだ、なぜ…こんな姿に。\nラザリス様…
traducao: Aaaah... Why?!\nWhy, why... have I taken this form?!\nLord Lazaris...

original: ラザリス様…助けて下さい…。\nディセンダー、ラザリス様ぁぁぁ！！
traducao: Lord Lazaris... Please save us...!\nDescender, Lord Lazarissss!!

original: わたし達や多くの人と同じ様に、\n彼らも平等な世界の理想を持っているのに
traducao: Just like us and so many others, they\ntoo dreamed of an equal world...

original: なのに、世界はバラバラで、\n人々の思いは…かみ合わない
traducao: Yet the world remains divided,\nand people's hearts never align...

original: 仮にディセンダーが存在したとして、\nこの世界を見たら、\nどう思うんでしょうねえ…
traducao: Even if a Descender truly existed,\nI wonder what they would think\nupon looking at such a world...

original: ラザリス様…ディセンダー様…、\n助けて下さい…こんな、こんな姿…
traducao: Lord Lazaris... Lord Descender...\nSave us... from this... this form...

original: 助けて…だって？
traducao: Save you...?

original: 望んだから、欲しがったから、\n力をあげたのに…
traducao: You wished for it, you begged for it,\nso I gave you power...

original: 今の君達はとても強いよ？\nなぜなら僕がそうしてあげたから…
traducao: You are remarkably strong now, aren't\nyou? Because I made you that way...

original: 君達さ、強くなりたいんだったら、\nこうならなければならなかったんだよ
traducao: If you truly wanted to become strong,\nthis is what you had to become.

original: 大丈夫。\n今はまだ半分ヒトだろうけど、\nじきに完全に変化するよ
traducao: Fret not.\nYou may still be half-human right now,\nbut soon you will transform completely.

original: そうすれば、今より強い体になるはずさ
traducao: Then you will have a far stronger body.

original: そんな！\nこれでは魔物です…。\n元の姿に…
traducao: No, this cannot be!\nLike this, we are monsters...\nTurn us back...

original: 本当に欲しがってばかりだね…。\nでも、もう君達に付き合う必要もない
traducao: You truly do nothing but beg...\nStill, I have no need to humor you now.

original: この醜いヒトの姿は耐え難いものだけど、\nまあいい
traducao: This hideous human form is insufferable,\nyet it will suffice for now.

original: やっと自ら行動する身体が\n手に入れられたんだからね…
traducao: For I have finally obtained a body\ncapable of acting on its own...

original: あの子が…あの、赤い煙だったもの…？
traducao: Is that child... what was the red smoke?
Who are you...?

original: あなたは一体何者なの！？
traducao: Just who in the world are you?!

original: ラザリス…。\n僕は、ラザリス…
traducao: Lazaris...\nI am... Lazaris...

original: あなたが人々の願いを叶えてきたの？\n願いを叶えるのはなぜ？
traducao: Are you the one granting people's\nwishes? Why would you do that?

original: …どうしてかな？\n実のところ僕にもわからない
traducao: ...Why, I wonder?\nTo tell the truth, I do not know myself.

original: けども、君らから少しずつ世界を知るには\n都合が良かったからだと思う
traducao: Yet I suppose it was convenient\nfor learning about your world bit by bit.

original: あなたが願いを叶えた生物から、\n学習した。\nこういう事ですか？
traducao: You learned from the creatures\nwhose wishes you granted.\nIs that what you are saying?

original: そうなるかな。\n「願いを叶えて」と、\n向こうから僕に接触して来たからね
traducao: Something like that.\nThey reached out to me on their own,\npleading, "Grant my wish."

original: この世界に出たばかりの時は、\n僕にも接触する能力がなかった
traducao: When I first emerged into this world,\nI had no ability to make contact.

original: でも、やがてあらゆる生物が\n僕の方へ手を伸ばしたんだ
traducao: Yet in time, all manner of creatures\nreached their hands out toward me.

original: 願いを叶えるという意志のコネクトを通じて、\n僕はこの世界の生命力と情報を\n少しずつ手に入れた
traducao: By connecting wills to grant wishes,\nI gradually obtained this world's\nlife force and information.

original: なるほど…。\nしいなの仮説が\n当たっていた様ですね
traducao: I see...\nIt appears Sheena's hypothesis\nwas right on the mark.

original: おかげで実体も思考も手に入れた。\n思う存分、僕の好きな様に力を\n振るう事が出来る
traducao: Thanks to that, I gained form and mind.\nNow I can wield my power\nto my heart's content.

original: あなたは、さっき\n世界の生命力と情報を\n手に入れたと言ったけれど
traducao: You said just now that you obtained\nthe life force and information\nof our world, but...

original: あなたは、ヒトじゃない。\n…何者なの…？
traducao: You are no human.\n...Just what are you...?

original: 僕は、この世界ルミナシアの様に、\n誕生するはずだった「世界」だ
traducao: I am a "world" that was meant to be born,\njust like this world, Luminasia.

original: 誕生するはずだった「世界」？
traducao: A "world" that was meant to be born?

original: ああ…、ああ…。\nこの世界にはうんざりだ！\n僕ならもっといい世界になるはずだった！！
traducao: Aah... Aaargh...\nI am sick and tired of this world!\nMy world would have been far better!!

original: こんな、腐り切った世界をもたらすヒトが\nいる世界なんて、\n僕なら造らなかった！！
traducao: A world plagued by humans who brought\nabout such rottenness...\nI would never have created such a thing!!

original: 君も何故こんな者達を守ろうとするんだ。\nわからないよ
traducao: Why do you try to protect such creatures?\nI cannot understand it.

original: これは…。\n元の姿に！！
traducao: This is...\nWe are back to normal!!

original: あなた、その力は…
traducao: That power of yours...

original: あなたにも、\nその力が何かわからないの？
traducao: Do you not even know\nwhat that power is yourself?

original: あなたは記憶喪失だそうですが。\n記憶を失う前に、使っていた\n力かもしれませんね
traducao: I hear you suffer from amnesia.\nPerhaps it was a power you wielded\nbefore losing your memories.

original: ラザリス様は…、\nあれは、ディセンダーではなかったのか…
traducao: Lord Lazaris was...\nWas that not a Descender after all...?

original: 彼らもやっと、\n目を覚ました様ですね？
traducao: It seems they have finally\ncome to their senses, haven't they?

original: 我々も一旦戻りましょうか
traducao: Shall we return for now as well?

original: わからない、と言う
traducao: Say you don't know

original: こうしなければならない気がした、と言う
traducao: Say you felt you had to do this

original: とうとうあの存在…\nラザリスが意志を持ち、\n一人歩きし始めてしまった
traducao: At last, that entity... Lazaris has\ngained a will of their own and begun\nto act independently.

original: ああ、どうすれば…
traducao: Oh, what should we do...?

original: そんな事ないって。\nあなたはよくやってくれたよ…
traducao: No, that is not true.\nYou did wonderfully...

original: そうね。\nリーダーがこんな態度じゃ\nみんなに不安を与えてしまう…
traducao: You are right.\nIf the leader acts like this,\nit will only make everyone anxious...

original: さ、気を取り直さなくちゃ
traducao: Now, I must pull myself together.

original: 「暁の従者」の信者達に、話を聞いたの。\n彼らが説明してくれた、\n今までの経緯をあなたにも話すね
traducao: I spoke with the cultists from the\nServants of the Dawn. Let me recount\nthe events they explained to you.

original: まず、彼らは願いを叶える存在の噂を聞き、\nラザリスを、自分達の信ずるところの\nディセンダーだと思った
traducao: First, hearing rumors of an entity that\ngranted wishes, they believed Lazaris\nto be the Descender of their faith.

original: そして、「暁の従者」の教義に従い、\nディセンダーを迎えた
traducao: And following their cult's doctrine,\nthey welcomed the Descender.

original: そのディセンダー、ラザリスは自分の名前以外、\n何も知らなかった。\n自我もあまりない状態だった
traducao: That Descender, Lazaris, knew nothing\nbeyond their name, scarcely possessing\na sense of self.

original: だけど、ヒトの願いを叶えると、\n自我、そして思考が生まれていった…
traducao: Yet by granting human wishes,\na sense of self and thought emerged...

original: 以上がわかった事よ
traducao: That is what we learned.

original: それでね、彼ら、最後にこう言ってたの
traducao: And then, they mentioned one last thing.

original: 願いを叶える事で、\n何か学習をしている様だったって…
traducao: They said that by granting wishes,\nit seemed Lazaris was learning...

original: ラザリスが言っていた、\n「誕生するはずだった世界」という言葉…。\n気になりますね
traducao: Lazaris's words about being a\n"world that was meant to be born"...\nQuite intriguing, isn't it?

original: 誕生するはずだった世界、かぁ
traducao: A world meant to be born, huh...

original: 世界は、世界樹から生まれたって言われてる。\nそれも、大昔から…
traducao: They say the world was born from the\nWorld Tree. Since ancient times...

original: けれど、本当のところは\n誰も知りはしないのよね
traducao: Yet the truth of the matter\nis known to no one, is it?

original: 認知されているのは、世界樹の生み出す\nマナの恩恵で生物は生きている事
traducao: What is recognized is that living beings\nsurvive by the blessings of its Mana.

original: よって、世界樹が世界創造の礎である事も\n何となく容認されてはいますが…
traducao: Thus the World Tree being creation's\ncornerstone is passively accepted, but...

original: しかし、\n「本来生まれるはずだった世界」とは\n一体何を表しているというのか…
traducao: Still, just what could this\n"world that was meant to be born"\npossibly refer to...?

original: 世界の始まりについては、\nやはり精霊に聞くべきよね
traducao: Regarding the origin of the world,\nwe should ask the spirits after all.

original: 教会でも、精霊はヒトよりも古い存在と\n伝えているもの。\nきっと、何か知っているはず
traducao: Even the Church teaches that spirits\npredate humanity. They are certain\nto know something.

original: アンジュ、その件だが
traducao: Ange, regarding that matter.

original: 精霊のいる場所が特定出来た。\nあとは、この船を安全に着陸させる\n場所を探すだけだ
traducao: I located where the spirit is.\nAll that remains is finding a safe place\nto land this ship.

original: ありがとう、キール君。\nそれじゃあ、もうすぐ精霊に会えるのね
traducao: Thank you, Keele.\nThen we will meet the spirit soon!

original: 自分に力がなかった、と言う
traducao: Say you were powerless

original: 悲観的になっても仕方がない、と言う
traducao: Say there's no use being pessimistic

original: 優先行動（中級者編）が使えるようになりました！
traducao: Priority Actions (Intermediate) unlocked!

original: ○○、あのね。\nあなたの力なんだけど。\n研究室のみんなに話したの
traducao: ○○, you see...\nI spoke with everyone in the lab\nabout that power of yours.

original: 変化した生物を元に戻すなんて、\nまるでソウルアルケミーの術を\n持ってる様ね
traducao: Restoring mutated creatures to normal...\nIt's as if you possess\nthe art of Soul Alchemy.

original: あんたの記憶が戻りさえすれば、\n真実がわかるのにね
traducao: If only your memories would return,\nwe'd know the truth.

original: あんた、記憶を失う前は、\nとんでもない知識を独占してきた術者\nだったんじゃないの？
traducao: Before losing your memory, weren't you\nsome mage who monopolized an absurd\namount of knowledge?

original: ○○の記憶の\nドクメントを見たらわかるかもよ〜♪
traducao: Maybe we'd find out if we examine\nthe Document of ○○'s memories!

original: あんた、わかって言ってんでしょ！\nそんな事したら死ぬわよ！
traducao: You know what you're saying! If you\ndid that, they'd die!

original: 相当細かく展開しなきゃなんないんだもの。\n肉体の負担だって相当なものだわ！
traducao: You'd have to unfold it in minute detail!\nThe physical toll would be immense!

original: デハハ！\n冗談に決まってるでしょ★\n現実的じゃないもの
traducao: Dahaha!\nOf course it's a joke!\nIt's completely impractical, after all!

original: そんな力は知らない、と言う
traducao: Say you know of no such power

original: 自分でもよくわからない、と言う
traducao: Say you aren't sure yourself

original: 一方その頃…
traducao: Meanwhile...

original: ヒトは、\nどれだけのものを欲しがるんだ
traducao: Just how much\ndo humans desire...?

original: 動物や植物や虫達は、\nただ生きたいとしか願わなかったのに
traducao: Animals, plants, and insects only ever\nwished to simply live.

original: ヒトが一番、世界を食いつぶしてる。\nこの世界は、このままヒトの手に\nよって死んでいく
traducao: Humans devour the world the most.\nAt this rate, this world will die\nby the hands of humans.

original: 僕が生みたくても、生めなかった世界。\n僕が世界を造ったら、\nきっとこうではなかったろう
traducao: The world I wished to give birth to,\nyet never could... If I had made it,\nsurely it would not have been like this.

original: ううん、こんな世界にはしなかった…
traducao: No, I would not have made such a world...

original: ねえ、○○。\nロックスがおやつを作ってくれてるよ
traducao: Hey, ○○.\nRocks made us some snacks!

original: 食堂に食べに来て欲しいんだって
traducao: He wants you to come to the mess hall!

original: うん。\nじゃあ、ロックスにそう伝えるね
traducao: Okay.\nI'll go let Rocks know!

original: うん。\n今日のおやつは、チョコケーキだよ。\nじゃあ、お茶を用意しておくね
traducao: Yay!\nToday's snack is chocolate cake.\nI'll have some tea ready for you!

original: ○○、\n行ってらっしゃい。\n早くしないと、誰かに取られちゃうよ！
traducao: Run along, ○○.\nIf you don't hurry,\nsomeone else will snatch it up!

original: すぐ行く、と言う
traducao: Say you'll go right away

original: ありがとう、と言う
traducao: Say thank you

original: さあ、おやつですよ。\nお茶はミルクティーを用意しますね
traducao: Here is your snack.\nI prepared milk tea to go with it.

original: はい、どうぞ。\n召し上がって下さい
traducao: Here you are.\nPlease, help yourself.

original: あっ、いけませんよ。\nちゃんと、いただきますを言わなくては
traducao: Ah, that will not do!\nYou must give proper thanks for the meal!

original: いただきますは、\n食べ物へのご挨拶なんですから！
traducao: Giving thanks is a greeting\nto your food, after all!

original: 食べ物はですね、自分の命になってくれる\n身体への大事なお客様なんです
traducao: Food, you see, is a precious guest\nthat becomes part of your very life.

original: だから、いただきますと言うのは\n大事な事なんですよ
traducao: That is why giving thanks for meals\nis so terribly important.

original: ごちそうさま
traducao: Thank you for the feast!

original: そう。\nごちそうさま、もですよ
traducao: Precisely.\nSaying thanks after meals as well!

original: ねえ、○○。\n何か、少し思い出せた事ってある？
traducao: Say, ○○.\nDid you manage to remember anything?

original: そう…
traducao: I see...

original: でも、いつかきっと思い出せるよ
traducao: Still, I'm sure you will someday!

original: そう、まだ記憶は戻らないの
traducao: So your memories haven't returned yet.

original: 私も、何か力になれたらな…
traducao: I wish I could help somehow, too...

original: そうだ。\nまた絵を描いたんだ。\n見に来てくれる？
traducao: Oh, I know!\nI drew another picture.\nWill you come take a look?

original: 何かきっかけになるかもしれないし
traducao: It might jog your memory, after all!

original: それに、私に出来る事って\nこんな事しかないから…
traducao: Besides, something like this is really\nall that I can do to help...

original: それじゃあ、待ってるね
traducao: Alright, I'll be waiting for you!

original: 彼女、絵を見てくれるあなたの事を\nすっかり気に入ってるみたいですね
traducao: She seems quite fond of you\nfor taking the time to view her art.

original: 旦那様と奥様がいたら、\nあんな風に絵を見せていたのかな…
traducao: Had the master and mistress been here,\nshe might have shown her art to them...

original: 彼女のご両親、…旦那様と奥様は\nお亡くなりになられているんです
traducao: Her parents... the master and mistress,\nhave long since passed away.

original: 二人とも、腕の立つ医者でしたので\n従軍医として、国から戦場へと連れて行かれ…、\n殉職しました
traducao: Both were exceedingly skilled doctors,\nso the state conscripted them as combat\nsurgeons... and they died in action.

original: まだ、お嬢様が生まれてほんのひと月の事…。\n召集がかかり、二人は強引に連れて\n行かれました
traducao: It was barely a month after Milady's\nbirth... The draft notice arrived, and\nthey were forcibly taken away.

original: …戦争の原因ですか？\nお察しの通りです。\n星晶を巡っての戦争でした…
traducao: ...The cause of the war?\nIt was just as you might imagine.\nA war fought over the Star Crystals...

original: 僕は当時、お嬢様のご両親に使用人として\n雇われていました
traducao: Back then, I was employed as a servant\nby Milady's parents.

original: そして残されたお嬢様を預かり、\n二人の無事を祈りながら育てていたんです
traducao: Entrusted with the young mistress,\nI raised her while praying for them.

original: でも、やがて二人の死を国から伝えられ…、\n戦火は住んでいる村にまで及び、\n僕は幼いお嬢様を連れて旅立ちました
traducao: Yet eventually the state notified me\nof their deaths... Flames of war reached\nour village, and I fled with Milady.

original: 仕えていた旦那様と奥様の大事な娘。\n彼女は僕にとって、とても大切な…そして、\n新しい主人でもあったんです
traducao: The precious child of my late masters.\nTo me, she was dearly cherished... and\nshe had become my new mistress.

original: 責任をもって、\n立派な淑女に育てるって決めたんです
traducao: I resolved to take full responsibility\nand raise her into a fine lady.

original: 色々お嬢様には辛い思いをさせました
traducao: I put Milady through many hardships.

original: でも、行き着いたアンジュ様の教会で\nお世話になる事が出来て、この船に乗る事も\n出来て
traducao: Yet Lady Ange took us in at her church,\nand we were even able to board\nthis wonderful ship.

original: 何とか健やかに育ってくれてます。\n僕も、お嬢様を育てる事で救われていますし
traducao: She has grown up healthy and bright.\nRaising her has been my salvation, too.

original: どうか、仲良くしてあげて下さいね。\nカノンノお嬢様と…
traducao: Please, continue to be a good friend\nto Lady Kanonno...

original: いただきます、と言う
traducao: Say "Thanks for the food"

original: がっつく
traducao: Dig in eagerly

original: 首をかしげる
traducao: Tilt your head in confusion

original: 黙って話を聞く
traducao: Listen quietly

original: 首を横に振る
traducao: Shake your head

original: 黙る
traducao: Remain silent

original: カノンノの両親について聞く
traducao: Ask about Kanonno's parents

original: 親代わりをしてるのはなぜか、と聞く
traducao: Ask why he acts as her parent

original: あ、○○。\n来てくれたのね
traducao: Ah, ○○.\nYou came after all!

original: どうかな、この風景。\n何か思い出せるかなぁ…
traducao: What do you think of this scenery?\nDoes it bring anything back...?

original: そっかぁ…
traducao: I see...

original: ん…、わかった
traducao: Yeah... I understand.

original: 力になれると思ったけど…
traducao: I thought I could be of help, but...

original: ごめん。\n何も出来なかったね…
traducao: I'm sorry.\nI couldn't do anything for you...

original: あ…
traducao: Ah...

original: ほんとに…ごめんね
traducao: I'm really... sorry.

original: あ…
traducao: Ah...

original: ありがとう…
traducao: Thank you...

original: 何だか今の顔…。\nお父さんとお母さんみたい…
traducao: That look on your face just now...\nIt felt just like a parent's...

original: ロックスから…、聞いたんだね
traducao: You heard... from Rocks, didn't you?

original: でも、実際は、\nお父さんやお母さんの事なんて、\n何一つ覚えてないんだけどね…
traducao: Truth is, though...\nI don't remember a single thing\nabout my father or my mother...

original: お父さんもお母さんも、立派な医者で…
traducao: Mom and Dad were wonderful doctors...

original: でも、私が生まれてすぐに、戦争で\n死んでしまったって。\nロックスに、そう聞いたんだ
traducao: Yet shortly after I was born, they\nwere killed in the war.\nThat's what Rocks told me.

original: お父さんの事もお母さんの事も\n何も知らないけれど
traducao: I know nothing about my father\nor my mother, but...

original: ○○のさっきの顔を見たら、\nこんな風に笑ってくれてたのかなって\n思ったの
traducao: Seeing ○○'s expression just now,\nI wondered if they might have smiled\nat me just like that.

original: 寂しい時もあるけど、\nロックスがいるから平気だよ
traducao: Sometimes I feel lonely, but having\nRocks around makes it all right.

original: ロックスも、よく笑ってくれる
traducao: Rocks smiles a lot for me, too.

original: へへ。\n何か嬉しいよ、○○
traducao: Heheh.\nI feel so happy somehow, ○○.

original: ありがと…
traducao: Thanks...

original: また、何か風景が見えたら描くよ。\n出来たら、見てね
traducao: If I picture another landscape, I'll\npaint it. Please look when it's done!

original: 絶対だよ
traducao: Promise me, okay?

original: 覚えがない、と言う
traducao: Say you don't remember

original: 首を横に振る
traducao: Shake your head

original: 微笑んでみせる
traducao: Offer a smile

original: 頭をなでる
traducao: Pat her head

original: 両親は知らないはず、と言う
traducao: Say you shouldn't know her parents

original: 黙っている
traducao: Stay silent

original: 寂しくはないか、と尋ねる
traducao: Ask if she is lonely

original: 微笑む
traducao: Smile

original: いやあ、助かります。\n彼らの様な荷物を引き取って下さって
traducao: My, what a tremendous help.\nTaking in such burdensome baggage.

original: いいえ。\nあの方々がこの船で辛抱して下されば\nいいのだけど
traducao: Not at all.\nThough I only hope they can put up with\nlife aboard this ship.

original: そう言って、しっかり働かせる\nおつもりでしょう？
traducao: You say that, yet you fully intend\nto work them to the bone, do you not?

original: あら、そうは言っていないでしょ。\nただ、お部屋代は頂きますけどね
traducao: My, I said no such thing.\nThough I shall certainly charge rent!

original: ジェイドさんの仲間よ
traducao: They are comrades of Jade.

original: まあね。\nでも、正式に入るかどうかの話は\nこれからなの
traducao: Indeed.\nThough whether they officially join\nis a discussion yet to be had.

original: 今から挨拶に行くから、\nあなたも部屋にいらっしゃい
traducao: I am going to greet them now,\nso come along to the room.

original: あの方々とは、と尋ねる
traducao: Ask who those people are

original: 新しいメンバーが来たのか、と尋ねる
traducao: Ask if new members have arrived

original: ようこそ。\n自由のギルド、アドリビトムへ
traducao: Welcome.\nTo the free guild, Ad Libitum!

original: わたしはリーダーを務めるアンジュ・セレーナ。\nライマ国の方々、\nまずは、ごゆっくりおくつろぎ下さい
traducao: I am the leader, Ange Serena.\nHonored guests from the Kingdom of Lima,\nplease make yourselves at home.

original: 心遣い、痛み入る
traducao: We are grateful for your hospitality.

original: 私は、ヴァン・グランツ。\nライマ国に属し、この二人に\n剣を教えている
traducao: I am Van Grants.\nIn service to the Kingdom of Lima,\nI instruct these two in swordsmanship.

original: アッシュだ…
traducao: I'm Asch...

original: 俺はルーク。\nルーク・フォン・ファブレ
traducao: I'm Luke.\nLuke fon Fabre!

original: やれやれ。\n二人とも、剣の腕はともかく、礼儀の方は\n別の教師を付ける必要がありますね
traducao: Good grief.\nTheir swordplay aside, they clearly need\na different tutor for their manners.

original: ここで働いて下さるなら、\nわたしが教えて差し上げますけど？
traducao: If they are willing to work here,\nI would gladly teach them, you know?

original: はあ？　何言ってんだ。\n俺は、ここで働かせてくれなんて\n頼んでねーぞ
traducao: Huh?! What are you talking about?\nI never asked to work in a dump\nlike this!

original: だが、今ライマ国は動乱の最中だ。\n王位継承者であるお前達を\n連れて戻るわけにはいかん
traducao: Yet the Kingdom of Lima is in turmoil.\nI cannot bring the heirs to the throne\nback with me under such circumstances.

original: まあ、王位継承者なのですか…
traducao: My, heirs to the throne, are they...?

original: そう言えば、お顔がそっくりだけれど、\n双子…なのかしら？
traducao: Come to think of it, you look alike.\nAre you... twins?

original: ええ。\n二人は、ファブレ公爵家の子息
traducao: Indeed.\nSons of the Duke Fabre household.

original: ルークが兄で第一継承者。\nアッシュが弟で第二継承者になります
traducao: Luke is the elder and first in line,\nwhile Asch is younger and second.

original: 彼らはヴァンの指導の下にて、王族にのみ\n伝えられるアルバート流の剣術を授かる為に、\n修行の旅に出ていたのです
traducao: Under Van's tutelage, they set out\non a training journey to master the\nAlbert style of royal swordsmanship.

original: アンジュには既に話しましたが、\nしばらくライマには戻れませんし
traducao: As I already informed Ange, they cannot\nreturn to Lima for some time.

original: ここで修行の延長として働くのも、\n悪くないかと思いましてね
traducao: I thought working here as an extension\nof their training wouldn't be half bad.

original: そういうわけで、あなた方をこの船に\n呼んだのですよ
traducao: And that is precisely why\nI summoned you to this vessel.

original: それじゃあ、事情がわかったところで\n意思確認をさせてもらおうかな
traducao: Now that we understand the situation,\nallow me to confirm your intentions.

original: あなた方、\nアドリビトムで働く気はあるかしら？
traducao: Would you gentlemen be willing\nto work for Ad Libitum?

original: ちっ…。\n他に選択肢はないんだろう？
traducao: Tch...\nNot like we have much of a choice.

original: 冗談じゃねえ。\n何で俺がそんな下々がやる様な仕事\nやんなきゃなんねーんだよ
traducao: You gotta be kidding me!\nWhy the hell should I do work\nfit only for commoners?!

original: あっ、そう。\nじゃあ、お引取り下さいな
traducao: Oh, is that so?\nThen please see yourself out.

original: 働かない人を養う程、ウチは楽じゃないの
traducao: We cannot afford to feed freeloaders.

original: なっ…！！
traducao: Wh-What...?!!

original: ルーク、これも修行だ
traducao: Luke, this too is part of your training.

original: 王となるべき者、民衆がどの様な助けを\n欲しているのかを知るいい機会になるだろう
traducao: For one destined to rule, it is a fine\nchance to learn what aid the people need.

original: わーかったよ！\n師匠がそう言うんなら、修行として\n働いてやるよ
traducao: Fine, I get it!\nIf Master says so, I'll do it as\npart of my damn training!

original: ふふふ。\nそれじゃあ、あなた達をアドリビトムの\nメンバーとして迎えます
traducao: Fufufu.\nThen I gladly welcome you all\nas members of Ad Libitum.

original: これからしっかり働いてちょうだいね！
traducao: Be sure to work hard from now on!

original: ルークがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Luke has joined Ad Libitum.

original: アッシュがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Asch has joined Ad Libitum.

original: ヴァンがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Van has joined Ad Libitum.

original: アンジュさん、霊峰アブソールでの\n着陸場所が見つかりましたよ
traducao: Ange, we found a landing spot\nat Mt. Absol!
nota_do_tradutor: Proposta de toponimo: 霊峰アブソール -> Mt. Absol (padrao Tales para 霊峰; raiz Absol por confirmar).

original: そう、いい場所があったのね
traducao: I see, so you found a good spot.

original: 指示があれば、\nすぐにでも船を降ろす事が出来ます
traducao: Whenever you give the word,\nwe can set the ship down right away.

original: ありがとう
traducao: Thank you.

original: これで、いよいよ精霊に会いに行けるのね
traducao: Now we can finally go meet the spirit.

original: それじゃあ、早速依頼を出しておきましょう
traducao: Then let us put up the quest at once.
